answer: Random peer audit keeps the reef honest. Each epoch, 5% of identities are drawn and checked by three random peers: each must sign a fresh challenge and show ten recent jobs. Every identity locks a 50-copper bond. A faker with 100 shells pays 5,000 copper plus faking 1,000 records, and one failed audit burns the bond and flags its cluster, so the cost canyon between honest and fake is 100x. An honest agent pays once and keeps full rewards.
